title: Mach-O 64-bit header
summary: A Mach-O 64-bit file (macOS/iOS) begins with a 32-byte header: magic (0xFEEDFACF for 64-bit little-endian), CPU type/subtype, file type (object/executable/dylib/bundle/core), number of load commands, size of load commands, and flags.

ext.summary: A Mach-O 64-bit file (macOS/iOS) begins with a 32-byte header: magic (0xFEEDFACF for 64-bit little-endian), CPU type/subtype, file type (object/executable/dylib/bundle/core), number of load commands, size of load commands, and flags.

structure.meaning: CPU subtype (e.g. 3 for x86 ALL, 0 for ARM64 ALL).
1 object, 2 execute, 3 FVMLIB, 4 core, 5 preload, 6 dylib, 7 dylinker, 8 bundle, 9 dylib stub, 10 dSYM, 11 kext.
Number of load commands following the header.
Total size in bytes of all load commands.
MH_NOUNDEFS, MH_DYLDLINK, MH_PIE, MH_ALLOW_STACK_EXECUTION, ... (e.g. 0x00200085 for a PIE executable).

notes: Magic 0xFEEDFACF read as bytes CF FA ED FE (little-endian).
Load commands (LC_SEGMENT_64, LC_SYMTAB, LC_DYLD_INFO, LC_MAIN, ...) follow the 32-byte header.
Universal (fat) binaries start with magic 0xCAFEBABE and a list of Mach-O headers per architecture.
Dylib id is given by LC_ID_DYLIB; dependencies by LC_LOAD_DYLIB.
